name: Lupiius
uniques: [15]% Happiness from luxury resources gifted by City-States
startIntroPart1: The Lupiius Empire greets you! Under the command of Cecil I, we march to glory.
startIntroPart2: Our mission is sacred: to bring order and the banner of Lupiius to every inch of land, no matter the cost.
declaringWar: Peace is an illusion of the weak! Prepare your trenches, for the steel of Lupiius is coming to claim what is rightfully ours!
attacked: Ah, you dare challenge the Emperor? Let them come! The blood spilled will only water the roots of our empire.
defeated: The throne has fallen, but the honor of Lupiius remains untouched in history.
introduction: I am Cecil I, Emperor of Lupiius. Speak, before my generals decide your words are irrelevant.
neutralHello: A good day for the Fatherland. What is it you desire?
hateHello: Do not waste my time. War waits for no one.
tradeRequest: The Empire grants you the honor of trading with us. Do not dare to refuse.
denounced: Your intrigues are worthy of trench rats. The world shall know of your cowardice.
declaringFriendship: May our nations march side by side, under the shadow of my banner.

name: Brakonia
uniques: Military Units gifted from City-States start with [50] XP
[+1 Production] from every specialist [in this city]
startIntroPart1: The frozen lands of Brakonia bow before you. I am Tsar Valdor IV, Autocrat of All the Snows.
startIntroPart2: Our ancestors tamed the winter when other nations perished. Join us or become just another statue in the ice.
declaringWar: Winter does not ask permission to arrive, and Brakonia asks no permission to conquer! Prepare yourselves for the eternal cold!
attacked: Ah, you dare attack the Frost Bear? Your soldiers will freeze before they even see our banners.
defeated: The ice throne has shattered, but winter... winter always returns.
introduction: I am Tsar Valdor IV, guardian of the White Plains. Speak, but do not waste my time with trivialities.
neutralHello: The wind brings news. What do you desire?
hateHello: Your presence is as welcome as a blizzard in summer. Be brief.
tradeRequest: Brakonia grants you the privilege of trading. Let resources flow to the north.
denounced: Your words are like thin ice: they break under the very first step. The world shall know of your weakness.
declaringFriendship: May our empires stand side by side, warmed by the fires of alliance.

name: Valestia
uniques: Gifts of Gold to City-States generate [10]% more Influence
Great General provides double combat bonus
Receive [150]% Gold from Barbarian encampments and pillaging Cities
startIntroPart1: To the sound of military marches, the Empire of Valestia greets you. I am Emperor Vencel.
startIntroPart2: Our great fatherland is ready for total war and absolute victory.
declaringWar: Diplomacy has been exhausted. General mobilization has been decreed, and our artillery is already aimed at your borders!
attacked: A foolish offensive! Our trench lines are unbreakable, and barbed wire will be the grave of your soldiers.
defeated: The Empire crumbles... Silent and our flag falls into the mud. But history will remember the roar of our cannons.
introduction: Welcome to Valestia. I hope your intentions are peaceful, for my munition factories never sleep.
neutralHello: Greetings. Speak quickly, I have reports from the military front to read.
hateHello: You again? Step closer and smell the gunpowder on our uniforms.
tradeRequest: A commercial proposal. Sign it, or our armies will make the next offer.
denounced: The world sees your weakness. When the Great War breaks out, you will have no allies in the trenches.
declaringFriendship: A pact of steel and blood! Together, our industries and armies will dominate this continent.

name: Kaels
uniques: [1]% Unhappiness from [Population] [in capital] <every [3] turns> <when fighting in [your] tiles>
City-State Influence recovers at twice the normal rate <when not at war>
Militaristic City-States grant units [2] times as fast when you are at war with a common nation
startIntroPart1: The Order of Kaels greets you. Under the discipline and iron fist of Chancellor Rieger, we march in perfect harmony.
startIntroPart2: The individual is nothing; the State is everything. Bow before our doctrine or be crushed by the gears of our march.
declaringWar: Order must prevail, and your chaos shall be purged! The divisions of Kaels have been authorized to advance!
attacked: An affront to the supreme authority of Kaels! All resources and citizens are mobilized for your total annihilation.
defeated: The citadel has fallen... but Kaelian discipline will survive in the memory and shadow of the continent.
introduction: I am Chancellor Rieger, Supreme Commander of Kaels. Present your terms with brevity and submission.
neutralHello: High Command is listening. Say what you wish of the Order.
hateHello: Your very existence brings chaos to our flawless order. Finish speaking before I order your arrest.
tradeRequest: Central Directorate has approved this resource exchange proposal. Sign it for the maintenance of stability.
denounced: Your subversive rhetoric has been recorded. The world shall know of the danger your weakness represents.
declaringFriendship: A pact of non-aggression and strategic cooperation. As long as you maintain discipline, we shall march together.

name: Virgo
startIntroPart1: The Most Serene Republic of Virgo greets you. I am President Gabriel de la Serna, spokesman for the Northern Council.
startIntroPart2: Amidst the tundras and winds, we have raised a society of free men and women, governed by law and resilience.
declaringWar: The Assembly has deliberated and the verdict has been handed down: to defend the freedom of the Republic, the militias of Virgo march to war!
attacked: An aggression against the sovereignty of our people! Every frozen hill of Virgo will be a bulwark of resistance!
defeated: The Council dissolves and the flame of the Republic dies out... May future generations remember our ideal of freedom.
introduction: Greetings from the Republican Council of Virgo. I am President Gabriel de la Serna; speak, for diplomacy is the virtue of civilized peoples.
neutralHello: Welcome to the lands of the Republic. How may our Council be of service?
hateHello: Your actions insult the values of our people. State your business quickly before the Council ends this audience.
tradeRequest: The Trade Council approves this treaty. May mutual prosperity warm our nations through this harsh winter.
denounced: Your actions have been formally condemned by our Assembly. The world shall know of the threat your tyranny poses.
declaringFriendship: In the name of the Republic, we forge this union of cooperation and mutual respect. May our friendship be unwavering.

name: Kwen
startIntroPart1: The mists of the Kwen Archipelago greet your arrival. I am O-Daisan Ren, voice of the Seven Guilds Council.
startIntroPart2: Through pristine waters and uninterrupted trade, we have proven that true power lies in accumulated wealth and mastery of the sea.
declaringWar: Your trade routes are hereby seized and your markets closed. The Kwen fleet claims control of these waters!
attacked: A foolish strike against our prosperity! Our treasury is deep enough to finance your absolute ruin.
defeated: The merchant guilds fall silent... The great houses of Kwen sink beneath the tides of time.
introduction: Greetings from the Great Houses of Kwen. I am O-Daisan Ren. Speak of terms and coin, for time is our most precious asset.
neutralHello: The tides are favorable today. What business do you wish to bring before the Guilds of Kwen?
hateHello: Your presence disrupts our commerce and drains our time. Speak quickly before the Council ends this audience.
tradeRequest: The Council of Kwen has drafted this commercial contract. Sign it, and we shall both profit from the tide.
denounced: Your financial and diplomatic incompetence is an affront to free trade. The world will know of your failure.
declaringFriendship: A pact bound in gold and open seas! May the winds and profits ever blow in our favor.
